Services

Three practices. One team.

AEO is the primary service. Media and PR, and event growth, sit beside it. Same team, whether you need citations, coverage, or a fuller room.

Primary service 01

AEO / AI search visibility

Answer Engine Optimization is SEO for AI answers. We help tech brands and event organizers show up when people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

The job is getting cited in the sources those models trust: editorial roundups, reviews, Wikipedia-style facts, and comparison articles. We publish clear product and event facts a model can quote, earn third-party mentions, and keep the brand’s facts consistent across the web. Then we track where the name appears in AI chatbots over time.

  • Prompt mapping for the questions buyers and attendees actually ask
  • Source targeting and PR into the outlets those answers cite
  • On-site content with clear, citable product and event facts
  • Citation tracking across AI chatbots over time
02

Media & PR

Coverage in top tech, business, and crypto publications. Press is how a brand or an event gets talked about before someone asks an AI, and it is one of the sources those answers draw from.

  • Story angles for the brand or the event
  • Outreach for features, reviews, and mentions
  • Third-party mentions in tech, business, and crypto publications
  • Facts kept consistent with the AEO work, so coverage and AI answers do not contradict each other

Founder credential, separate from client placements: Anupam Varshney has been a Cointelegraph contributor since 2017, with bylines in Forbes, VentureBeat, Business Insider, CoinMarketCap, and Hackernoon.

03

Event growth

Sponsorship sales and ticket sales, taken off the organizer’s plate. We close sponsors and sell tickets so the team on the ground can run the event.

  • Sponsorship deck and tier pricing, prospecting, outreach, negotiation, and closing
  • Sponsor contacts across exchanges, wallets, protocols, AI companies, and fintech companies
  • Paid ads on Meta, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn
  • Lead generation, email and WhatsApp campaigns, and community and partner promotions

Deliverables

The pieces that make the three practices repeatable.

These sit inside the work above. They are not a fourth brand.

Sponsorship deck and pricing

The offer, the tiers, and the numbers an organizer is willing to sell. Built for the outreach, not as a leave-behind that never gets used.

Email and WhatsApp campaigns

Direct follow-up for sponsors and for ticket buyers, alongside the paid ads.

Post-event sponsor reports

What a sponsor receives after the event, written so the next conversation is a renewal.

Citation tracking

Where the brand shows up across AI chatbots over time, tied back to the prompts and the sources we went after.

Pricing

Performance-friendly where the revenue is. Retainers where the work is coverage and citations.

Event growth

A retainer, plus commission on sponsorship revenue and per ticket sold. You pay for the desk that has to run before a contract, and again when sponsor money and tickets come in.

AEO and Media & PR

Retainers. Prompt mapping, source outreach, citable pages, press, and citation tracking are scoped on the call. We do not publish dollar amounts here.
